protocol_name: DermaStack-XAI Stage 6 Frozen Holdout Test Evaluation Protocol

evaluated_models.selection_rationale: Primary maximum-likelihood research baseline optimizing overall accuracy and probability calibration without post-hoc class re-weighting.
High-sensitivity clinical screening baseline neutralizing empirical prior log-odds to maximize recall on minority and malignant lesions (mel, df, vasc, akiec).

metrics_specification.accuracy: Fraction of correct classifications (argmax class == true class).
metrics_specification.macro_precision: Unweighted mean of per-class precision across all 7 classes, zero_division=0.
metrics_specification.macro_recall: Unweighted mean of per-class recall across all 7 classes, zero_division=0.
metrics_specification.macro_f1: Unweighted mean of per-class harmonic F1-score across all 7 classes, zero_division=0.
metrics_specification.roc_auc_ovr_macro: Multiclass One-vs-Rest Area Under the ROC Curve, macro-averaged across all 7 binary classification tasks using predicted probabilities.
metrics_specification.multiclass_log_loss: Negative log-likelihood of true class probabilities, clipped to [1e-15, 1 - 1e-15].
metrics_specification.multiclass_brier_score: Mean squared difference between predicted class probabilities and one-hot true indicator vectors: (1/N) * sum_i sum_c (p_{i,c} - y_{i,c})^2.

governance_and_integrity_rules: Rule 1: Zero Holdout Leakage — The holdout test set was not accessed during training, fold validation, OOF generation, meta-learner fitting, or protocol specification.
Rule 2: Frozen Decision Boundaries — Predictions must use the standard argmax decision rule; no post-hoc threshold tuning or recalibration is permitted on test data.
Rule 3: Separate Reporting — Validation and holdout test metrics must be reported separately; mixing, pooling, or averaging test and validation metrics is strictly prohibited.
Rule 4: Dual-Model Transparency — Both Standard Stacking and Balanced Stacking must be evaluated and reported side-by-side to expose the clinical precision-vs-recall trade-off.
